name: TPS54202
description: Cheap 28 V, 2 A synchronous buck in SOT-23-6: the default way to make 5 V or 3.3 V from a 12 V rail or a 3S/4S battery.
notes: Fixed 500 kHz with spread spectrum; FB reference 0.596 V.
28 V max: fine for 12 V and up to 5S Li-ion, too little margin for 24 V lead-acid systems.
Pin-compatible with TPS54302 (3 A) and LMR51430 (36 V).

en.note: Internal pull-up current (Ip 0.7 µA, +Ih 1.55 µA hysteresis); float EN to enable. Rising threshold 1.21 V typ, falling 1.19 V typ. Recommended operating max 5.5 V, so do not tie to VIN. Use open-drain logic to control. Optional UVLO divider R4 (VIN-EN) / R5 (EN-GND) per eq. 1-2; typical app (Fig 7-1, 8-28 V in) µses R4 = 511k, R5 = 105k.

notes: Fixed 500 kHz (390-630 kHz), +/-6% spread spectrum; Eco-mode pulse skipping at light load (no FCCM option).
Internally compensated peak current mode. Keep crossover < 40 kHz; without Cff, fo ~= 3.95 / (VOUT x COUT) (eq. 14, COUT in F).
Cff (C6, across top resistor R2) = 1 / (2*pi*fo*R2) (eq. 16); 75 pF in the 5 V design. Not needed with high-ESR COUT; reduce it with medium-ESR COUT.
LMIN = VOUT*(VINmax-VOUT)/(VINmax*KIND*IOUT*fSW) (eq. 8); KIND up to 0.3 with ceramic COUT, 0.2 with higher-ESR caps. Table 7-2 L values are for VIN = 28 V.
Output cap: CO >= 2*dIOUT/(fSW*dVOUT) for load step (eq. 11); typical app 2 x 22 µF 25 V X7R.
Input: >10 µF ceramic decoupling (typical app 10 µF), optional 0.1 µF HF cap; add ~47 µF electrolytic bulk if the supply is more than a few inches away.
Datasheet suggests R2 (top) ~100k; 49.9 ohm R1 in series with the top resistor in Fig 7-1 is only a loop-injection point (optional).
Can run at 100% duty cycle while BOOT-SW > 2.1 V. Internal 5 ms soft start. Hiccup OCP (512-cycle wait, 16384-cycle restart). Low-side source current limit 3 A typ.
Datasheet gives no explicit VOUT range; catalog vout 0.6-26 V is not stated in the datasheet.
design.pages: SLVSD26C (Rev C, Feb 2026). Pin functions p3; abs max (EN 7 V, VIN 30 V, BOOT-SW 7 V) p4; recommended EN max 5.5 V p4; VFB 0.596 V, EN thresholds, Ip/Ih, I(LIM_HS) 3.2 A typ, fsw p5; tMIN_ON 110 ns p5 (timing table); EN/UVLO eq. 1-2 p9-10; R2 100k start p10 sec 6.3.8 and p14 sec 7.2.3.3; boot 0.1 µF + 100% duty p11 sec 6.3.10 and p14; typical app Fig 7-1 p13; Cin p14 sec 7.2.3.1; KIND, eq. 8 p15; Cout eq. 11-14 p15-16; Cff eq. 16 and Table 7-2 p16-17; bulk 47 µF p20.
